remarks:
Welcome to your new home! 10745 S. Roberts Rd. (extension) is the spacious, cozy home you have been searching for in Chautauqua Country. 

Tucked away on a county road that offers privacy, this large property sits on 40 acres of country property providing flat land which could be used as pasture, it offers apple trees and space for additional fruit trees or veggie gardens. The wooded lot provides a stream as well as opportunities for anyone who likes to hunt or bird watch, and enjoy nature. Use the pole barn for additional storage for all of your outside activities such as boating, skiing, or snowmobiling or for storing a tractor or ATV for property maintenance. How about a hobby shop, do you need one of those? An attached garage provides ample space for parking and for storage and makes it easy to load and unload your car after a day of adventures, keeping you nice and dry. Leading up to the home is a paved driveway so no more mud to deal with or stones to have to rake back into place after winter.

This property is in the perfect location - only 2 miles from the City of Dunkirk and Lake Erie for enjoying live music on the pier, visiting the lighthouse and Point Gratiot Park, spending a day at the beach, watching sunsets over Lake Erie, shopping, dining, or hopping onto I-90 for adventures.  This location is also close to one of the local snowmobile trails that connects with a bigger trail system. 

This home is attractive to buyers who like to find ways to save money with the owned on-site windmill with estimated savings of $500-$1,000 (or 16,000 kw hours) annually off your electric bill. The windmill is quiet and was built to fit into the plane of the land.  The property is also attractive to homeowners who like space to entertain, space to spread out, flex spaces that can be used in multiple ways, space for a guest suite, and more! The home provides vaulted ceilings making the larger spaces feel even bigger.  The home offers natural light, a spacious kitchen with a formal dining room, a hot tub on the deck, a pellet stove in the living room to take the chill off during the cooler months, central air to keep cool during the warmer months. And more!
